Container.Name: OpenNutriTracker
Container.Overview: Calorie and nutrient tracker (web version for the desktop). Your data stays encrypted in the browser and syncs end-to-end encrypted with the phone app. Open it over HTTPS: https://[IP]:8443 (self-signed certificate; accept the browser warning once).

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: Open the app at https://IP-of-unraid:this-port. Browsers only run it over HTTPS (or localhost).

Config.Name: HTTP port (for a reverse proxy)
Config.Description: Plain HTTP for Nginx Proxy Manager / SWAG / Tailscale serve, which add the certificate. Opening it directly shows a page pointing to HTTPS.

Config.Name: Certificates
Config.Description: Keeps the self-signed certificate across updates (so the browser warning doesn't come back). Put your own cert.pem and key.pem here to use them instead.
